description.value: Cliff McNabb Arena is a City of Nanaimo municipal ice arena located in Nanaimo on Vancouver Island. It is part of the city's parks and recreation network, offering skating programs and arena activities. It functions primarily as a local sports facility rather than a visitor attraction.
